results.content: The AAII Investor Sentiment Survey, however, shows individual investors are not buying the optimism. Bearish sentiment has been above its historical average for 27 consecutive weeks. Bullish sentiment is below average for the fourth straight week. As a contrarian indicator, that persistent skepticism has historically been a tailwind for equities. But it also means that the next negative catalyst could trigger a sharper move than current positioning suggests.
